text: Tivoli Marina Vilamoura sits between Vilamoura's marina and the beach, and the town's golf courses are a short drive inland: [Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal) is about **10 minutes** away by car, [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna), [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium) and the [Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course) about 12, and [Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol) about 15. Vale do Lobo is about 23 minutes away. **Last checked: November 2026.**

text: The nearest courses at a glance

Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer. The four Vilamoura courses are run by Vilamoura Golf, which allows 4 hours 40 minutes for a round and pairs players into four-balls.

**[Vilamoura Pinhal](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal)** (par 72, 6,353 m, slope 140): Frank Pennink's 1976 course through the pines, the closest to the hotel and the toughest of the Vilamoura courses on slope. See the [Pinhal hole-by-hole guide](/courses/vilamoura-pinhal/hole-by-hole).

**[Vilamoura Old Course](/courses/vilamoura-old-course)** (par 73, 6,254 m, slope 136): Pennink's 1969 original and Vilamoura's most famous course, lined with umbrella pines, and its most expensive round. See the [Old Course scorecard](/courses/vilamoura-old-course/scorecard).

**[Vilamoura Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna)** (par 72, 6,121 m, slope 135) and **[Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium)** (par 72, 6,176 m, slope 130): the two flatter, more open courses, sharing a clubhouse and the lowest green fees in Vilamoura, from €88. Millennium is the easiest on slope, and Laguna has a free shared buggy offer for new bookings made by 31 December 2026.
**[Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol)** (27 holes, slope 135 to 137): Donald Steel's Pestana course just outside Vilamoura, with three nines played in pairs and a €60 twilight rate from 3.30pm.

**[Vale do Lobo](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal)** (Royal: par 72, slope 133; Ocean: par 73, slope 140): about 23 minutes east, home of the Royal's famous clifftop 16th. Its Sunset rate, from €76 in winter, includes a shared buggy for full-paying adults.
Golf at Tivoli Marina Vilamoura

The hotel has a golf page on its official website, which says its team can help with golf arrangements and arrange transfers to the courses on request. Golf package sellers also list a golf desk and a free shuttle to the Vilamoura courses here, but shuttles can depend on the package you buy, so ask the hotel which courses it serves and at what times before you rely on it.

It's a big resort that suits golfers travelling with non-golfing partners or family, with the beach, pools, a spa and the marina's restaurants on the doorstep. For other hotels in the area, see [golf hotels near Vilamoura](/guide/golf-hotels-near-vilamoura).

text: Which course to play from Tivoli Marina

**For the classic round,** play the Old Course. Read [Vilamoura Old Course vs Millennium](/guide/vilamoura-old-course-vs-millennium-which-one-should-you-play) or [Vila Sol vs the Old Course](/guide/vila-sol-vs-vilamoura-old-course-which-should-you-play) if you're choosing.
**For value,** Laguna and Millennium start at €88, and Vila Sol's twilight rate is €60. See [the cheapest golf in Vilamoura](/guide/cheapest-golf-in-vilamoura).
**For a change of scene,** Vale do Lobo and Quinta do Lago are under half an hour east.
Getting there

Tivoli Marina Vilamoura is about **40 minutes and 27 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Vilamoura with golf clubs](/guide/faro-airport-to-vilamoura-with-golf-clubs) for taxis, transfers and car hire.
Golf near Tivoli Marina Vilamoura: common questions
What is the closest golf course to Tivoli Marina Vilamoura?
Vilamoura Pinhal, about 10 minutes away by car, followed by Laguna, Millennium and the Old Course at about 12 minutes.
Does Tivoli Marina Vilamoura have a golf shuttle?

Its golf page says the team can arrange transfers to the courses on request, and package sellers list a free shuttle to the Vilamoura courses. Check the details with the hotel, as shuttles can depend on your package.
Can I walk to a golf course from Tivoli Marina?
Not really. The courses are inland from the marina, and the closest, Pinhal, is about 4 km away by road.
Do I need a handicap to play near Tivoli Marina Vilamoura?

Yes. The Vilamoura courses, Vila Sol and Vale do Lobo ask for a handicap certificate of up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
